instruction: Look up Frozen toys for girls and organize them from cheapest to most expensive.

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for Frozen toys for girls on kohls.com and sorting by price low-high. Similar complexity to original with popular Disney franchise. Evaluator uses check_direct_json_object.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks both filtering requirements (Frozen, Toys, Girls) and sorting requirement (Price Low-High)
Getter 'get_active_tab_html_parse' with category 'class&url' can extract breadcrumb elements (pmpSearch_breadcrumb), sort selector (sbSelector), and URL parameters
Metric 'check_direct_json_object' correctly compares extracted boolean values against expected values
Expected values structure is correct - when type='rule', the metric receives the rules dict directly with 'expected' key containing boolean flags
Multi-faceted verification uses both DOM element extraction (class names) and URL parameter checking for robustness
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding explicit verification of the actual product list order (first product price < last product price) for stronger sorting validation, though URL parameter check is likely sufficient
The 'is_other_exist' check ensures no unexpected filters are applied, which is good defensive verification
